genie.howToUseConversationStarter.reply:
It's easy – just type in the search bar. I can suggest scenes, create new scenes or even control your lights. For example, you could ask me to set a relaxing scene or turn off the living room lights.
If I don't get it right the first time, try rephrasing. I'll get better as I learn!

genieConsent.subtitle:
By tapping I approve, you consent to the automated processing of your personal data to generate personalised lighting scenes for your Hue devices. Your personal data will be used solely for this purpose. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our <link:privacy>Privacy Notice</link:privacy>. 
 
Want to revoke your consent and deactivate the Hue AI-powered assistant later? Tap the three dots in the assistant, or go to <emph>Settings > Account</emph> and then tap No.

genieSearch.whatsHueGenie.description1:
The Hue AI-powered assistant lets you use prompts to interact with your system. No commands necessary. Just type what you want your lights to do! 

Our AI assistant can help you to improve your lighting experience.

Here's what it can do (for now!):
genieSearch.whatsHueGenie.description2:
Keep in mind that it may not always fully understand the context of what you’re saying, and it can make mistakes. 

While it can provide recommendations, it may not always be the best fit for your specific needs. If that's the case, please disregard the recommendation and use the Hue app as you normally would. 

It’s important that any information you provide complies with <link:terms>Hue Terms of Use</link:terms> (see specifically the “Your conduct” section) and is included as “User Submissions” as defined therein.
